title: Marketing evolution lane A: give Features, Spaces, The Community and Stories their own layouts

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-04: the rewritten marketing pages are flat and text based; make each a different layout that speaks to the feature, program or service, with images and the design system's textures.

detail: Words, headings, schema, links and form behavior kept. /features is a product tour (hero tour map with dotted connectors, full-bleed photo covers with glass headings, sticky job heading beside a bento of feature panels, signal-line dividers). /spaces is a host-your-own-world showcase (four full-bleed photo chapters with glass panels, a Space page in the Nocturne theme in a browser and iPhone 390 frame, photo cards for the five kinds on a phone scroll-snap rail, a tool sheet). /the-community is people and places (photo collage hero, photo marquee, stat band of real network numbers that hides when the read fails, dotted timeline with photos cut as Circles, glass cards over a photo). /stories is editorial (arch-cut masthead photo, photo-masked pull quote, lead story card with three staggered, form on glass over a night photo). Styles in the new app/themes/frequency/site-pages-showcase.css, scoped per page; every loop stops for reduced motion. /stories is still hidden behind the 2026-10-14 302 in next.config.ts.
